project_info.theme: Toyota safety on every journey for families
project_info.color_palette: Black, soft green, white, warm beige

main_subject.detail: A gentle family-safety poster shot from inside a Toyota cabin looking out through the passenger-side window. The interior door, steering wheel edge, side mirror, and roofline frame the composition. Outside, a smiling father holds a young child while the mother stands beside them in a green park setting. Bottom text reads 'AN TOAN TREN MOI CUNG DUONG'.
main_subject.style: Soft lifestyle brand poster using a real in-cabin frame as a visual metaphor for safety and protection

composition_elements.text: AN TOAN / TREN MOI CUNG DUONG
items: Top Left: Dark roofline, rear-view mirror, and upper interior framing
Top Right: Green park foliage outside the passenger window
Bottom Left: Steering wheel edge, dashboard corner, and side mirror
Bottom Right: Bold tagline 'AN TOAN TREN MOI CUNG DUONG'
Center/Background: A happy mother, father, and child seen through the open passenger-side view, framed by the vehicle interior

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle greenery glow, subtle cabin shadowing, warm protective mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota family safety story. Centerpiece is a view from inside a Toyota cabin looking out through the passenger-side window at a smiling father holding a child beside a mother in a green park. Background is framed by the vehicle's interior roofline, door panel, mirror, and steering wheel, creating a protective visual enclosure. Surrounding elements: exact text 'AN TOAN TREN MOI CUNG DUONG'. Technical style: photoreal lifestyle automotive brand composite, soft natural family-lifestyle lighting, gentle greenery glow and protective mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Do not simplify this into a generic family portrait. The key device is that the family is seen through the car window from the inside, making the cabin itself part of the message.
